AJIT KUMAR – JM FINANCIAL Bajaj Finserv Limited November 03, 2026 # Page 2 of 18 Moderator: Ladies and gentlemen, good day, and welcome to the Q2 FY2027 Earnings Conference Call for Bajaj Finserv Limited, hosted by JM…
GWP for Bajaj General grew at 10% for the quarter to about INR 7,056 crores, which is marginally lower than the industry growth of about 12%.
Also, on margin outlook, we are at 19.2% for first half, maybe on rolling 12 months, almost 21%.
And there is also an impact of about INR 50 crores due to the capital reduction we've done through buyback and dividend in the last 6 months.

strengths: The consolidated total income grew 17% to INR 43,416 crores, consolidated profit after tax grew a healthy 25% to INR 5,952 crores and consolidated profit after tax attributable to the owners grew 23% to INR 2,758 crores.

However, if we were to exclude the bulky tender-driven crop and government health business, the GWP for the Company increased by a very healthy 21%, which is significantly higher than the industry growth of close to 13%.
weaknesses: GWP for Bajaj General grew at 10% for the quarter to about INR 7,056 crores, which is marginally lower than the industry growth of about 12%.
Loan losses to AUF ratio declined to 1.56% this quarter versus 1.88% for the same period last year.
Accordingly, the gross and the net NPAs stood at 1.06% and 0.42%, respectively, much lower than the same period last year.
threats: Like I mentioned, we saw pricing intensity in non-par, and that's when we said it makes more sense to do more annuity and do different things there.
